name: Mystery Trackers: Raincliff's Phantoms
storyline: Now you see us… now you don’t. It should have been a lighthearted human interest story, but what Emilie White reported on in this abandoned town scared her witless – and now she’s vanished. Nobody can say what happened to her, and only a few like you know the stories of invisible people living there are true... Return to Raincliff, where what you see isn’t always what you get.
summary: Mystery Trackers: Raincliff's Phantoms is the sixth title in the Mystery Trackers series and in developed by Elephant Games.
